# 🏢 EmpireFlow

## 💡 Overview

**EmpireFlow** is a modern Minecraft **tycoon plugin** where players build their own economic empire by investing in businesses that generate passive income over time — even while offline.

Designed for long-term engagement, **EmpireFlow** combines idle mechanics with active decision-making, creating a deep and rewarding progression system.

![Details](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d85bfa1474b264f3986d02f60a4db0a724c0201.png)

The plugin focuses on:

* long-term progression
* idle + active gameplay balance
* strategic economy management
* GUI-driven experience
* competitive leaderboards

---

# ⚙️ Main Command

```
/empire
```

Aliases:

```
/emp /ef /flow
```

---

# 📌 Subcommands

* ```/empire open``` → Opens the main business GUI
* ```/empire collect``` → Collect accumulated income
* ```/empire stats``` → View personal statistics
* ```/empire top``` → View economy leaderboards
* ```/empire settings``` → Toggle sounds, notifications, UI options
* ```/empire level``` → Manage player progression level
* ```/empire reload``` → Reload configuration (admin)

---

# 🖥️ GUI SYSTEM (CORE FEATURE)

## 🎨 Modern Interface Design

EmpireFlow features a fully interactive, polished inventory GUI:

* 54-slot inventory layout
* paginated business system
* smooth navigation
* real-time updates
* sound + visual feedback
* **fully customizable items, colors, and lore**

---

![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70b56702a78f07f6e585ee0ffae6df9c22506e26.png)

## 🧭 Main Business GUI

When a player runs `/empire`, they open the main empire interface.

### 🏢 Business Display System

* 🟢 Unlocked Businesses:

  * custom item icon
  * income/hour display (auto-updating)
  * level and upgrade information
  * full stats in lore

* 🔒 Locked Businesses:

  * barrier item display
  * required level
  * unlock cost
  * message: "You have not unlocked this business yet"

![GUI2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca6501a0594f21035872dbb488bd7d747da0e57e.png)

---

## 🛒 First Business UX Improvement

* the first business is NOT locked behind a barrier
* it appears as available for purchase immediately
* improves early-game experience

---

# 🏢 Business System

EmpireFlow includes 10+ fully **configurable** businesses:

* Farm
* Mine
* Fishery
* Lumber Mill
* Quarry
* Bank
* Casino
* Laboratory
* Trading Port
* Dragon Farm

Each business is **stored** in its own YAML file.

---

# 📈 Income System

* generates passive income at configurable intervals
* works both online and offline
* income is stored until manually collected
* real-time notifications when income is ready
* income display updates based on config (no hardcoded values)

![Income](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/122c6dc723d75055345661174c7c0b2bc98ca7cb.png)

![OfflineIncome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d7ac8ae7d189bbbd655221cc8b45c12ab78ef90.png)
---

# 💸 Upkeep System

* hourly maintenance cost per business
* if unpaid:

  * business stops generating income

![Upkeep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbb2e9fe1ea53dd47575fcc7d2fb824885cd31c2.png)

---

# 🔼 Upgrade System (3 Separate Paths)

* 💰 Increase Income:

  * boosts payout per cycle

* ⏱️ Reduce Interval:

  * decreases time between income cycles

* ⚙️ Efficiency Upgrade:

  * reduces upkeep or adds bonus effects

Each upgrade has a max level of 10.

![Upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12c2330151da97dbcc7f749e5090ebed0c551d78.png)

---

# 📊 Empire Info System

* live GUI stats panel
* player level progression
* total businesses owned
* total income
* progress bar (XX/XXX format)

![Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8e66ebe1b773e481f4639259736ffc734c7d1bf.png)

---

# 🏆 Leaderboard System

* highest income per hour
* most valuable empire
* total money earned across all businesses

![Leaderboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e8f9ca7a4ec606602af73cc4cf6248596691581.png)

Rewards:

* top players receive global income boosts

---

# 🎁 Events System

* ⚡ Golden Hour:

  * x2 global income

* 📅 Daily Bonus:

  * x2 income for 1 hour

* 🎲 Random Events:

  * business-specific boosts
  * global modifiers

---

# 📢 Notifications System

* income cycles completed
* taxes paid
* boost events activated
* offline earnings summary on login
* income ready alerts

---

# 🧠 Progression System

## 📊 Player Level

* increases through economic activity
* unlocks new businesses
* **configurable** money goals per level

## 🌐 Global Tech Tree

* +% global income
* -% upkeep costs
* +% offline earnings

---

# ⚙️ Admin Commands

```
/empire level add <player> <level>
/empire level set <player> <level>
/empire reload
```

Permission:

```
empire.admin
```

---

# 🧾 Smart Help System

```
/empire help
```

* shows only commands available to the player
* admins see additional commands

![HelpCommand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a088c6823b1969191c51cbf2acaccc01bbc4d5f.png)

---

# ⚙️ Settings Menu

```
/empire settings
```

* toggle sounds
* toggle notifications

---

# 💰 Economy Integration

* fully integrated with Vault
* supports:

  * EssentialsX
  * any Vault-compatible plugin

---

# 🔐 Permissions

* empireflow.use → basic access
* empireflow.admin → admin features
* empire.admin → level management
* empireflow.reload → reload config

---

# 🚀 Performance

* async task handling
* optimized scheduling system
* no lag spikes
* modular architecture
* fully configurable systems

---

# 🎯 Final Goal

EmpireFlow delivers a modern Minecraft tycoon experience that combines:

* idle income generation
* strategic upgrades
* deep progression systems
* competitive economy gameplay
* highly customizable GUI-based management

Perfect for:

* survival servers
* RPG servers
* economy servers
